hero.title: Together, so that equal
hero.description: Engagement für Integration e.V. is a recognised migrant-led organisation. We work with conviction to build bridges, dismantle prejudice and make equal opportunities real for everyone.

mission.heading: Our mission: solidarity, education and equal opportunity
mission.intro: Since we were founded we have accompanied people with a migration or refugee background through their first steps and along their long-term path in Germany. We are a point of contact, a guide and a dependable partner.

engagement.subtitle: Inclusion & solidarity
engagement.title: Our commitment
engagement.desc: Founded on firm values of inclusion and lived solidarity, our organisation works actively for the successful integration of migrants and refugees — whatever their origin, language or religion.

mission.subtitle: Lasting independence
mission.title: Mission & purpose
mission.desc: As a non-profit migrant-led organisation, our central task is to give newcomers the tools they need to develop on their own terms and to contribute to society as equal citizens.

diversity.subtitle: Support across the board
diversity.title: Diversity as a strength
diversity.desc: We see diversity as a strength for Germany as a whole. Our work covers every area of life: access to basic services such as housing, multilingual education, healthcare, and practical support with language and entering the labour market.

partnerships.subtitle: Together, locally
partnerships.title: Strong partnerships
partnerships.desc: Working closely with municipalities, city authorities, schools, regional businesses and committed volunteers, we deliver targeted programmes for empowerment and social participation.

welcome.subtitle: Awareness & dialogue
welcome.title: A culture of welcome
welcome.desc: We actively foster intercultural dialogue and mutual respect through open meeting spaces, community festivals, awareness workshops and direct exchange with wider society.

future.subtitle: Creating prospects
future.title: A future with dignity
future.desc: We work towards a future in which everyone — whatever their origin — has the chance to fulfil their potential in dignity and equality.

sidebar.heading: We are here for you
sidebar.emailNote: A reply within 24 hours on working days.

team.heading: The people behind EFI e.V.
team.intro: Dependability, intercultural experience and genuine commitment shape the leadership of our organisation.

anita-nga.name: Anita Nga
anita-nga.description: Leads our integration and education initiatives and coordinates the women's and family projects.

partners.heading: Our partners & supporters
partners.intro: Together with strong institutions and providers, we deliver effective measures for social participation.

form.heading: Asking is already a first step
form.intro: Do you have questions about the association or our services, or would you like to volunteer? Write to us directly.
form.successText: We have received your enquiry and will get back to you as soon as possible.
